obras.synopsis_en: Made entirely in the front seat of a car with simple art tools direct to film, this handmade short celebrates the joy of Montréal road maps, travel and jazz music.

obras.synopsis_es: Una paleta de colores fluorescentes, imágenes angulosas y afiladas y un coro jubiloso se conjugan de forma exquisita hasta un crescendo épico, en el gozoso relato animado de Ronni Shalev sobre dos recogepelotas de una pista de tenis cuya rivalidad inicial se transforma en una pasión eléctrica y magnética.
obras.synopsis_en: A major tennis tournament is about to begin, and the tension is palpable. On the court, two ball girls crouch on either side of the net. Each believes her moment has arrived. They want to be the best ball girls in the tournament's history. The ultimate ball girl championship.  But when the match begins and the girls look into each other's eyes, they are surprised to discover another force beyond the net: attraction. A dynamic that begins as bitter rivalry transforms into a magnetic passion, during which the girls search for a way to escape the competition that stands in the way of their love.

obras.synopsis_en: Death’s patience is tested as his sweet and gentle apprentice appears incapable of the task, leading him to seek professional help from the most unlikely of places.

A Long Goodbye tells the story of Ida, a 72-year-old pianist living with dementia. In this animated, interactive VR experience, we walk in Ida’s shoes. We experience a day in her life, as her reality is fading.

It’s an ordinary day at the United Nations. Nothing unexpected, really. Except, perhaps, for this strange affliction that is spreading amongst the members of the council. But otherwise, everything is fine. Yes, everything is perfectly fine.
Welcome to Mississauga where lawns are clipped, neighbors are watchful and no blade of grass dares misbehave. Except at Wolf Ruck’s place. His lawn grows wild, and so does the trouble.

obras.titulo: A voz de todas as cousas
obras.titulo_original: A voz de todas as cousas
obras.synopsis_es: ¿Podríamos escuchar la canción de nuestro primer amor sin recordar el lugar? Cuatro músicos de jazz tocan en un club de la ciudad. Se comunican a través de miradas y silencios. Ya casi no queda gente en las calles, pasan los últimos autobuses de la noche, cierran los comercios, retumban los camiones de la basura, las olas del mar chocan contra las piedras, y la luz del faro aparece y desaparece en el agua. Como si fuese el fin del mundo. A la mañana siguiente, los sonidos brillarán a plena luz del día. (Filmoteca de Galicia)
obras.synopsis_en: Could we listen to the song of our first love without remembering the place? Four jazz musicians play in a club in the city. They communicate through glances and silences. There are hardly any people left on the streets, the last buses of the night pass by, shops close, garbage trucks rumble, waves crash against the rocks, and the light from the lighthouse appears and disappears in the water. As if it were the end of the world. The next morning, the sounds will shine in the bright light of day.
obras._busqueda: A voz de todas as cousas

obras.titulo: About Happy Hippos and Sad Peacocks
obras.titulo_original: About Happy Hippos and Sad Peacocks
obras.synopsis_en: How did peacocks, originally from India, end up on an island in Berlin in the 19th century, and hippopotamuses, a century later, on the banks of a river in Colombia? Their lives there appear to be “happy and free”. With rapturous imagery, Elkin Calderòn Guevara and Johannes Förster’s decolonial fable turns them into wild icons, bearing witness to the whims of the powerful.
obras._busqueda: About Happy Hippos and Sad Peacocks

obras.synopsis_en: On 19 July 1929, in a village in Colombia, a group of shoemakers fought to improve living and working conditions in the country. They called themselves "The Bolsheviks of Líbano, Tolima". Their revolution lasted only one day and there was an attempt to erase their trail. The women of this village meet Aura, an anarchist grandmother, with the feeling that their rebellion is still going on.

In the outskirts of Lima, eleven-year-old Chito cares for the carrier pigeons used in his brother’s drug trade. After violence shatters his childhood, grief and a fragile gesture of humanity open the possibility of another destiny.

obras.synopsis_es: La pequeña Alma camina por una calle nevada camino de su casa cuando repara en una enigmática muñeca expuesta en el escaparate de una juguetería. Fascinada por ella, decide entrar...
obras.synopsis_en: Amidst the chilly white winter, bright-eyed Alma, wanders through Barcelona’s cobblestone streets. Suddenly, she spots an unassuming toy shop. Her gaze is drawn to a nearly identical figure staring back at her from the storefront window. As if by magic, the shop’s door swings open. But to her bewilderment, her elusive twin is nowhere to be found.
One day, Gustav hears a rumor that he will be replaced by another butler; the anxiety and uncertainty grow so strong within him that one night he decides to escape.

obras.synopsis_es: Una mujer rural colombiana planea donar su cuerpo a la ciencia y encarga su propio retrato póstumo, en una tierna e ingeniosa meditación sobre la vida, la muerte y el cuerpo humano.

obras.synopsis_en: An exploration of Barcelona through light, as it falls on the streets of the city and the people around me who live there: my chosen family. The sun as a brush that naturally highlights what can be seen and what remains in the darkness, clashing with the human artifice of the city, captured with my filmmaker's gaze. A gaze affected by being a lesbian from a small town in Lleida who's been living in Barcelona for 13 years. A journey from the intimacy of the rooms, friends and lovers that surround me, through the narrow streets of the Raval district to the sunset on the mountain of Montjuïc. From the city to urban nature, the lights and shadows, its people and their ability to be and exist.

A guide, responsible for sending fallen stars back up to the sky, encounters a fallen star that cannot return. That star changes into a creature doomed to remain on the ground. Angry and confused, it lashes out, chasing the memory of what it once was. With the help of the guide, it is able to accept its fate, and together they can guide the stars back up, brighter than before.
Two astronauts attempt to plant their flag on a newly discovered planet. But first, they need to get rid of some pesky aliens whose business there is unknown.
Paris, June 2024. It's summer, it's Pride, but Maël is getting ghosted and Emilie just got dumped. Luckily, somewhere in the crowd, Maël meets Emilie and Emilie meets Maël.

Baisanos follows the fans of the Club Deportivo Palestino, weaving a dialogue between Chile and Palestine. Through reflections on identity and return, two distant lands connect in a space of celebration, where hope for victory is the promise of a possible future.

Hot wax painting on a Barcelona directory; a palimpsest reflecting the violence and madness of the riots that shocked Spain in October 2019.

obras.synopsis_es: Maite, Unai y Merche son los estudiantes de encuadernación de Alicia. Comparten un taller donde cortan, cosen y pegan hojas para alargar la vida de los libros. Mientras cada uno trabaja en su libro conversan sobre la vida, el duelo y sus variaciones.
obras.synopsis_en: Alicia teaches book binding to students Maite, Unai and Merche. They share a workshop where they cut, sew and glue the pages to give the books a longer life. While each one works on their book, they talk about life, grief and its different variations.

The film lets the members speak for themselves, captured entirely on 16mm film and underscored by an original synth score.

Her impossibly long braid is a living symbol of strength and empowerment. “Chingona” is a bold visual anthem about carving your own path and owning every step forward. It’s the story of a city swallowed by an eternal night, where little by little everyone, adapting to the darkness, starts turning into owls. As the tale unfolds, it becomes clear that Vera, too, is part of the story.

obras.synopsis_en: A soul waits to be reincarnated while reflecting back on her past life as a nun, who worked at the Vatican Astronomical Observatory in early-20th century. There, she took part in the “Carte du Ciel” — an ambitious international project to map the night sky, earning the early title of “computer” as a result of processing repetitive calculations. Disillusioned with her previous existence, she considers becoming a coder in her next life, amidst the wave of economic optimism awaiting her reincarnation in 1990s Portugal. Shot on 16mm film and smartphone, "Oh Be a Fine Girl Kiss Me" blends historical fiction and autobiography in a meditation on life’s choices and constraints, as well as on the systems and categories that shaped modernity.

Martí, overwhelmed by the chaos of the city, arrives late to pick up his younger brother, Ángel. For Ángel, living with his brother has always tested his patience. A visceral and poetic portrait of masculine connection—built from blows, shoves, long silences, and, at times, a kind of untamed love.

Mientras intentan alertar a las autoridades sobre la inminente llegada de un asteroide, este diverso grupo enfrenta los desafíos de la autorrepresentación en el cine. Así, a través de la improvisación, reflejan sus propias experiencias, perspectivas y reflexiones sobre la vida y la muerte.

obras.synopsis_en: On an ordinary night in Madrid, Manuel — a young, upper-class conservative — unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend Lucía outside a nightclub. Told through subtle, everyday moments, the film offers a raw and emotionally resonant look at love, loss, and self-discovery.

obras.titulo_original: Esa fugaz esencia que dejaron los sucesos
obras.synopsis_es: Walter Benjamin definió la huella como la «aparición de una cercanía, por más lejos que ahora pueda estar eso que la ha dejado atrás». Las calles de Barcelona están pobladas de las huellas de pequeñas y grandes luchas que han realizado las mujeres a lo largo de la historia. Algunas apenas se perciben, centellean, se ocultan. Otras se han convertido en huellas intencionales, placas o monumentos que intentan reconstruir y actualizar el pasado que la Historia con H mayúscula ha querido borrar. Este film busca esta cercanía de la que habla Benjamin, el vestigio de una historia alternativa a la oficial que es necesario salvar del olvido. Es la investigación de la fuerza histórica de estas mujeres consideradas excepciones, notas a pie de página.
obras.title_en: That Fleeting Essence Left by Events

obras.synopsis_es: A orillas de una represa hidroeléctrica, cuya construcción sepultó el antiguo cauce del río Cauca, un grupo de mujeres se reúne para bordar. Cubren el río de flores para invocar a sus muertos, en una geografía tejida por hilos de memoria y resistencia. El espíritu de los cuerpos arrojados al río y cubiertos por la represa inconclusa navega junto a los peces en el agua. Las almas emergen vestidas de fuego para escuchar el canto que les envían sus madres y hermanas desde la vida.

LGBTQ+ asylum seekers in Belgium face an impossible ask: prove their identity by reliving the worst things that have happened to them. For people who have hidden their queerness their whole lives just to survive, the asylum process demands the opposite: total openness, total detail, to complete strangers. Red Elephant follows those caught in this cruel contradiction, many of whom have fled deeply conservative, homophobic societies only to encounter a system that requires them to narrate their most painful experiences as evidence. The film gets close to the reality of what this process feels like; the waiting, the vulnerability, the absurdity of turning personal identity into a bureaucratic checkbox. Red Elephant is a powerful story about what gets lost when the price of safety is exposing the very thing you were taught to hide.

obras.synopsis_es: Somorrostro es el nombre que actualmente recibe una playa de Barcelona. En 1961 mi abuelo se acercó a ella con una cámara de súper-8 y filmó el barrio de barracas que se desplegaba entonces frente al mar: gaviotas, niños, bailes y ropa tendida le parecieron cinematográficos. Al cabo de treinta años, en 1991, la ciudad se preparaba para las Olimpiadas de 1992 y mi abuelo volvió a filmar en el mismo lugar, esta vez con una cámara de vídeo y fascinado por la construcción de las torres Mapfre y la renovación del paseo.  Han pasado otros treinta años, y en 2022 discotecas y turistas se amontonan sobre la arena. Me aproximo a este espacio, donde mi abuelo filmó dos veces, para buscar quién y cómo lo habita hoy y buscar vínculos con el archivo. Somorrostro en tres actes mezcla tres tiempos y tres formatos cinematográficos para tratar de reflejar los cambios operados en la ciudad de Barcelona en los últimos sesenta años, así como captar la transformación de las formas de filmar.
obras.synopsis_en: Through three different moments, between the sixties, the nineties and the present, the director portrays an emblematic place in Barcelona that has gone from being a marginal corner to becoming one of the epicenters of mass tourism. Somorrostro, now the beach, before the neighborhood, is the object of this dialogue between archival and current images that is also the reunion, between frames, of a granddaughter with her grandfather.

Sergio Cortesi dedicated his life to solar observation.  At the “Specola solare” in Locarno, between 1957 and 2021, he made over 15.000 sunspots drawings, driven by the faith of a monk to whom his own god never gave an answer.

Soñé con Zapata (I Dreamed of Zapata) – “Soñé con Zapata” is an experimental short film that explores the migrant experience from a poetic and sensory perspective, articulating the concepts of memory, identity, and displacement through moving images and sound design.  The work is set within the context of Mexico’s complex relationship with migration—as a country of origin, transit, and destination—and proposes an intimate reflection that seeks to build empathy. Based on a fragmented narrative, the short film constructs an emotional journey where the personal sphere intertwines with the collective.  “Soñé con Zapata” is conceived as an act of poetic and cultural resistance that re-signifies a fundamental icon of Mexican history, drawing inspiration from the choreography “Zapata” (1953) by Guillermo Arriaga. The work invites reflection on the links between body, territory, and freedom, offering no closed answers but rather opening a space for interpretation and dialogue.

Red Dress. No Straps..synopsis_en: Year 1985. Tehran. Iran-Iraq war. It’s just an ordinary evening at the grandparents’; Grandad is listening to Voice of America on the radio. Red Elephant.synopsis_en: LGBTQ+ asylum seekers in Belgium face an impossible ask: prove their identity by reliving the worst things that have happened to them. For people who have hidden their queerness their whole lives just to survive, the asylum process demands the opposite: total openness, total detail, to complete strangers. Red Elephant follows those caught in this cruel contradiction, many of whom have fled deeply conservative, homophobic societies only to encounter a system that requires them to narrate their most painful experiences as evidence. The film gets close to the reality of what this process feels like; the waiting, the vulnerability, the absurdity of turning personal identity into a bureaucratic checkbox. Red Elephant is a powerful story about what gets lost when the price of safety is exposing the very thing you were taught to hide.

Somorrostro en tres actes.synopsis_es: Somorrostro es el nombre que actualmente recibe una playa de Barcelona. En 1961 mi abuelo se acercó a ella con una cámara de súper-8 y filmó el barrio de barracas que se desplegaba entonces frente al mar: gaviotas, niños, bailes y ropa tendida le parecieron cinematográficos. Al cabo de treinta años, en 1991, la ciudad se preparaba para las Olimpiadas de 1992 y mi abuelo volvió a filmar en el mismo lugar, esta vez con una cámara de vídeo y fascinado por la construcción de las torres Mapfre y la renovación del paseo.  Han pasado otros treinta años, y en 2022 discotecas y turistas se amontonan sobre la arena. Me aproximo a este espacio, donde mi abuelo filmó dos veces, para buscar quién y cómo lo habita hoy y buscar vínculos con el archivo. Somorrostro en tres actes mezcla tres tiempos y tres formatos cinematográficos para tratar de reflejar los cambios operados en la ciudad de Barcelona en los últimos sesenta años, así como captar la transformación de las formas de filmar.
Somorrostro en tres actes.synopsis_en: Through three different moments, between the sixties, the nineties and the present, the director portrays an emblematic place in Barcelona that has gone from being a marginal corner to becoming one of the epicenters of mass tourism. Somorrostro, now the beach, before the neighborhood, is the object of this dialogue between archival and current images that is also the reunion, between frames, of a granddaughter with her grandfather.

Soñé con Zapata.synopsis_en: Soñé con Zapata (I Dreamed of Zapata) – “Soñé con Zapata” is an experimental short film that explores the migrant experience from a poetic and sensory perspective, articulating the concepts of memory, identity, and displacement through moving images and sound design.  The work is set within the context of Mexico’s complex relationship with migration—as a country of origin, transit, and destination—and proposes an intimate reflection that seeks to build empathy. Based on a fragmented narrative, the short film constructs an emotional journey where the personal sphere intertwines with the collective.  “Soñé con Zapata” is conceived as an act of poetic and cultural resistance that re-signifies a fundamental icon of Mexican history, drawing inspiration from the choreography “Zapata” (1953) by Guillermo Arriaga. The work invites reflection on the links between body, territory, and freedom, offering no closed answers but rather opening a space for interpretation and dialogue.

Cegada por el sol tropical, Margot deambula por la ciudad, ajena a todo lo que la rodea. Lejos de los demás y de su entorno, sus fantasías se funden con la realidad. Su mirada se cruza con la de un hombre en la calle, con el pecho desnudo y los ojos penetrantes. Cada día, Margot sigue al joven, acercándose lentamente al objeto de su deseo.

Tenéis que verlo.synopsis_en: Luis and Ana visit another couple of friends who have just had a baby. The Birthday Gift.synopsis_en: On an icy Chicago night, an unexpected guest upends the lives of an Argentine mother and daughter over the course of an intimate birthday dinner.

The Getaway.synopsis_en: On a road somewhere in Ukraine, Ana, an aid worker for a Spanish NGO, helps Yrina flee the bombings with her son, Yure. They want to reach the border as quickly as possible and get to safety.

The Recce.synopsis_en: Drawing on a location test filmed in Uganda and an email exchange with the scout, this short film captures cinema’s ties to land and its entanglement with colonial imaginaries, binding the fiction of filmmaking with state-building.

The Reward.synopsis_en: Inspired by dreams of glory and fame, two young boys set out on the treasure hunt of their lives.

The Soloists.synopsis_en: In a small village ruled by ridiculous laws, three singing sisters and their dog rehearse for the Annual Autumn Festival. But an unexpected event will disrupt their plans.

The Tide Inside.synopsis_en: A Colombian teenage girl in Los Angeles begins to unravel as the threat of deportation creeps into her world. Though raised to believe herself strong, a quiet unease grows inside her, as fear pulls her away from everything that once felt safe.

The Undying Pain of Existence.synopsis_es: Un modelo desnudo posa con una quietud casi escultórica para una exclusiva clase de dibujo... hasta que una inoportuna picadura de mosquito pone a prueba su autocontrol. Impulsado hacia la locura por el picor, queda atrapado entre la exigencia implacable de perfección y sus impulsos más desatados y primarios.
The Undying Pain of Existence.synopsis_en: A nude model is posing with statuesque stillness for an elite drawing class – until an unfortunate mosquito bite challenges his self-control. Driven to madness by the itch, he’s caught between the ruthless demand for perfection and his most unhinged, animalistic impulses.

They’re Here.synopsis_en: Edén Villa (pseudonym) and anonymous Minneapolis residents evade and resist the paramilitary occupation of their city, in a winter landscape where masked agents abduct children, residents travel in trunks, shackled prisoners are loaded onto airplanes within eyesight of vacationers, and bicyclists track the movements of an invading force.

To the North.synopsis_en: In 2025, after 471 days of war, during a brief ceasefire in Gaza, Firas returns alone to the north to recover his sister and her family from beneath their collapsed home.

Todas las manos que solté.synopsis_en: Twenty years after her mother’s death, Laura returns to the family home in Cauca, Colombia. Vagabundo.synopsis_en: A solitary man traverses landscapes. He travels, contemplates, and dreams. He seems to possess nothing except the backpack that accompanies him and interacts almost without any interaction with other human beings during his journey. Without him seeming to notice, a dog crosses his path at every step. Perhaps it is looking for an owner.

Vers la forêt.synopsis_en: In a quiet stop-motion studio, a small monkey opens its eyes. Everything around it feels frozen. On a computer screen, a luminous jungle appears, distant, almost alive. With two companions, he sets out to create one of their own, using whatever they can find. A forest shaped by imagination, their only way out.

Virgin Fandango.synopsis_en: A short musical film that uses an innovative technique of animated tiles, featuring a rebellious Mary joining her voice to those of celebrated women throughout history in the fight for equality.

X-Story.synopsis_en: A guy equipped with the latest model of bionic power arm gets a map and a mysterious ball from a clandestine dealer, and begins the search for a treasure that is hidden inside an abandoned tower in the desert.

Yndige mennesker.synopsis_en: As supernatural forces slip through the cracks, four destinies are intertwined, and four souls are forced to confront their demons. A young woman’s hope for a fresh start is derailed by a mysterious enchanted mirror, while her psychiatrist is struck by visions of a terrifying accident. In the nearby city, a care worker uncovers dark and perverted secrets as he tends to a dying man, and writer’s block turns demonic for an ambitious musician.
